_comment: Per-weekend F1 car upgrades, curated from the official FIA 'Car Presentation Submissions' documents (one per GP; the doc teams legally submit declaring new parts). Keyed by round → { gp, date, doc, teams:[{team, items:[{component, reason, detail}]}] }. Only teams that submitted updates are listed; the renderer derives the 'no updates' teams from the F1 roster. `detail` is a short factual summary of the geometric change (not F1.com's editorial prose). Source: fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_<gp>_-_car_presentation_submissions.pdf. Curation-first (see docs/research/2026-07-06-f1-upgrades-data-source.md). R1-R11 curated (R1 = launch-spec cars under the new 2026 regs).

1.note: Season opener — most entries are the launch-spec cars declared under the new 2026 regulations rather than upgrades over a previous car.
